bob_customer: hey team — since the auth migration at 09:12 UTC our clients see streaming responses that end abruptly ~25-35% of the time. The stream stops before the final JSON object; finish_reason is absent and client JSON parse fails. repro steps below.

alice_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the raw SSE payload you received (raw bytes) and the SDK/curl command you used? also share any proxy in front (CF, Fastly) and whether tokens rotate mid-request.

bob_customer: here's a minimal curl repro we run from our mobile proxy env (we're on Cloudflare + internal edge LB). token rotates on idle refresh every 60s. curl command:```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx" -N "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-alpha"
```raw stream (trimmed):
```
data: {"id":"resp_01","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello, this is the start"},"index":0}]}

data: {"id":"resp_01","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" continued text"},"index":0}]}

data: {"id":"resp_01","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" final sentence"},"index":0}]}

data: {"id":"resp_01","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"\n"},"index":0}]}

data: {"id":"resp_01","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{"},"index":0}]}  <-- the client shows this last line; stream closed immediately after, leaving an unterminated object and no finish_reason
```

bob_customer: we captured upstream headers: `connection: keep-alive, transfer-encoding: chunked`, and proxied via Cloudflare HTTP/2 to our edge which does token refresh. trace-id: trace-9c7a1b.

alice_support: thanks — can you also paste the exact time + request-id from our API (x-request-id / x-trace-id) so we can locate server-side logs? and confirm whether the client ever sees a TCP FIN/RST or just EOF on the stream?

bob_customer: x-request-id: rwd-20260315-9c7a1b. Client sees EOF (stream closes) immediately after the partial chunk; no explicit HTTP error code is returned. Network team saw Cloudflare send a 200 then connection close (no 502).

carmen_oncall: @alice_support :eyes: this looks like a keepalive/proxy cut during token rotation on the client path. We've seen similar where the proxy initiates a connection swap and the HTTP/2 stream gets torn down leaving the last chunk partial. Not the same as auth-rotate 2598765432 but similar symptom. Can you get a pcap/tcpdump showing the three-way close? Also ask customer to repro with `--http2 -N --no-buffer` to rule out client buffering.

dave_sre: couple things to try/recommend: 1) reproduce with `socat`/raw netcat to see whether TLS termination is dropping mid-chunk; 2) temporarily increase keepalive/idle timeout on the proxy to >120s; 3) as a mitigation, our SDK can emit a final sentinel event `data: {"final":true}` so clients have a deterministic end marker even if finish_reason is missing.

bob_customer: we can run tcpdump tomorrow. quick question — is there anything on your end that would intentionally close the SSE with an incomplete final object when token rotation happens?

alice_support: no intentional close from the API side — our runtime should flush the final event then close. If tokens are rotated at the proxy layer (client side) mid-request, that can interrupt the TLS session. we'll escalate to eng-runtime and attach your trace id. opening internal ticket INC-20261 and linking customer support case CS-9982.

carmen_oncall: engineering note: eng-runtime to check code path around `send_final_event()` when `auth.revalidate()` triggers async socket swap. Suspect a race where KV cache resume + socket swap cancels the flush.

dave_sre: for repro script try: `curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer <rotating token>" -N ...` and concurrently rotate token (call auth refresh) to force the edge to close. If you can capture `RST_STREAM` or `FIN` timestamp we can correlate with server logs.

alice_support: next steps: 1) bob_customer — please send pcap and exact times, we'll attach to INC-20261. 2) eng-runtime to triage for race on socket flush during auth revalidate. 3) temporary workaround: add client-side sentinel parsing or retry the stream on parse error.

bob_customer: will collect tcpdump and send within 24h. thanks for quick triage.

alice_support: thanks — we'll aim to respond with a mitigation plan in 24-48h. tagging @dave_sre and @carmen_oncall. :thumbsup:

ingest_bot: Incident INC-20261 created by alice_support at 2026-03-15T12:40:10Z

bob_customer: noted. appreciate the help.
